typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsRateIndexCalypsoMapping_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		INTERFACE_VALUE as string,
		CALYPSO_VALUE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromcalypsodbacalypsomapping
fromcalypsodbacalypsomapping derive({Copy of CALYPSO_VALUE} = CALYPSO_VALUE,
		{Copy of INTERFACE_VALUE} = INTERFACE_VALUE) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		interface_value as string,
		calypso_value as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		interface_value = {Copy of INTERFACE_VALUE},
		calypso_value = {Copy of CALYPSO_VALUE}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsRateIndexCalypsoMapping_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsRateIndexCalypsoMapping
